I stand before you today as the CEO of the Boys and Girls Club of Ottawa County  to express our unwavering commitment to the betterment of our community,  particularly for our youth who are the future of this community.  Tonight we are here to discuss the important Teen Center Project,  specifically the construction of a much needed gymnasium  which has garnered significant attention and sparked a healthy dialogue within our community.  As you can see, we have additional community members here this evening  in support of our Teen Center Project.  They have come prepared to make a public statement in support of our project,  but given the statements we have already made directly to the council,  in addition to the negotiations we have attempted to make with Friends of the Coleman,  we don't find it necessary to spend any more time on this matter  and understand the council is ready to vote this evening and move forward.  I want to thank these community partners for taking the time  to show up this evening in support of the club  and for standing committed to the progress of our community.  First and foremost, I want to emphasize that we have approached this project  with an open heart and an earnest desire to collaborate with all stakeholders involved.  We understand the concerns raised by Friends of the Coleman  and want to assure the council and the community  that we have taken their questions and concerns seriously.  We have engaged in numerous conversations and meetings,  actively seeking to address the points of view and explore possible compromises.  Our commitment to collaboration extends far beyond mere words.  It is reflected in our actions.  We have made a conscious effort to engage in a constructive and inclusive dialogue,  working tirelessly to ensure that our project aligns  with the best interests of our community as a whole.  We value the input and expertise of Friends of the Coleman  and consider them an important partner in our collective mission  to improve the lives of youth in our community.  We have listened to their concerns regarding the impact of our project  on the historical significance of the Coleman Theater,  and we have taken steps to ensure that our plans are respectful at this cherished landmark.  We have also explored potential solutions to mitigate traffic  and parking challenges to alleviate any disruptions to our neighboring properties.  We have expressed our commitment to working with them to ensure events  at the Coleman Theater continue without any potential issues.  As an organization dedicated to serving the youth of Ottawa County,  we are deeply committed to enhancing the lives of young people.  The Teen Center project, including the gymnasium, is a crucial component of this commitment.  It will provide a safe and inclusive space for our teens to engage in physical activity,  educational programs, and positive social interactions.  We want to ensure the Council and the community that our dedication to serving  the youth of Miami is not limited to the immediate project, but extends for years to come.  The Teen Center will be a place where countless young lives will be positively impacted,  where lifelong friendships will be forged, and where dreams and aspirations will take root.  In conclusion, we want to thank the Council for their careful consideration of our project  and express our sincere gratitude to the Friends of the Coleman for their engagement  and their concern for our community's heritage.  We're committed to continuing this dialogue, to finding calming ground,  and to ensuring that the Teen Center project enriches the lives of our youth  while preserving the historical and cultural fabric of Miami.  We kindly ask for your support as we move forward, united in our shared goal of creating  a brighter future for the youth of our beloved city.  Together, we can make Miami an even better place to grow up and thrive.  Thank you for your time, and I'm happy to answer any questions. However, to ensure  that our youth can reach their full potential, we must provide them with the right tools and  opportunities. The Boys and Girls Club has a long history of serving as a pillar of support for our  community's youth.
